The probe's finding of record this batch: vaultwarden's unauth surface is WIDER than previously recorded. Prior batches leaned on the 127.0.0.1:8062 host bind to call the unauth legs 'LAN/insider-scoped', but that bind only constrains the DIRECT container port — traefik_auth_modes.vaultwarden='oidc' attaches NO forward-auth middleware to the auto-published Host(`pass.<tld>`) router, so anonymous HTTPS transits the edge into the app over iiab_net/shared_net. GENERAL LESSON for future native_oidc services: 'oidc' in traefik_auth_modes means the EDGE IS OPEN and the app's own login is the only gate — pre-auth endpoints (icons, websockets, health, well-known) of every native_oidc service are anonymously reachable and must be scored as such.
